title: Chana Pulao (Chickpea Pulao)
tagline: A hearty, protein-rich pulao of chickpeas and basmati with warming spices.
intro: Chana pulao is a satisfying vegetarian one-pot that's popular for lunchboxes and quick dinners. Tender chickpeas are simmered with onions and spices, then the basmati cooks right in the same pot, soaking up all the flavour. Filling, wholesome and budget-friendly.

items: 400 g (2 cups) basmati rice, soaked 20 min
250 g (1½ cups) cooked chickpeas (or 1 can, drained)
1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp red chilli powder
1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, 3 cardamom, 1 bay leaf

method: Heat oil, add cumin and whole spices, then the onions; fry until golden.
Add ginger–garlic paste, chillies and tomatoes; cook until softened.
Add the ground spices and the chickpeas; sauté for a few minutes.
Add the drained rice and stir gently. Add the water and salt.
Boil, then cover and cook on low until absorbed, 12–15 minutes.
tips: Canned chickpeas make this a genuinely 30-minute meal.
A squeeze of lemon and fresh coriander at the end brightens it.
toServe: Serve with raita or a simple salad.
